scripts.build: bun run build:openlia-browser && bun run build:ui
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:openlia-browser && bun run typecheck:ui
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:ui && bun test packages/openlia-browser
scripts.format: biome format --write packages tests package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages tests package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint packages tests package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify-dist: bun run build && test -s packages/openlia-browser/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/server.js && test -d packages/workspace-ui/dist/client/assets
